`heal_allies_near(hero.global_position, range, 40 + hero.heal_power, hero.team)`.

the common `Unit.heal()` path clamps to max HP, so the current Hero is included.

`apply_slow(-1.0)`, which leaves an existing positive slow unchanged because the
API uses `max(_slow, t)`. Passive Hero aura ownership remains separate.
